Full-Stack Engineering Blueprint

Project Architecture, Database Schema & Linux VPS Guide

Complete modular breakdown of the FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + PostgreSQL/SQLite codebase packaged in blockhub_fullstack.zip.

Modular Repository Structure 

blockhub/
├── backend/
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── config.py          # Env vars, zero hardcoded secrets
│   ├── database.py        # SQLAlchemy PostgreSQL / SQLite engine
│   ├── models.py          # 14 relational SQLAlchemy models
│   ├── schemas.py         # Pydantic v2 input & URL validation
│   ├── security.py        # PBKDF2-SHA256, JWT, CSRF, rate limit
│   ├── seed.py            # Verified launcher dataset seeder
│   ├── main.py            # FastAPI app, security headers, SPA mount
│   └── routes/
│       ├── auth.py        # Register, login, verify email, reset
│       ├── launchers.py   # Search, filter, download safety, reviews
│       ├── developer.py   # Submit, edit, changelog, image upload
│       ├── admin.py       # Moderation queue, bans, audit logs
│       └── seo.py         # sitemap.xml, robots.txt, notifications
├── frontend/
│   ├── templates/index.html
│   └── static/uploads/
├── deploy/
│   ├── blockhub.service   # systemd production unit
│   └── nginx_blockhub.conf
├── tests/
│   └── test_app.py        # Automated E2E backend verification
├── .env.example
├── requirements.txt
└── README.md

14 Relational SQLAlchemy Models

  • 1. User & 2. UserProfile: Role-based accounts (guest, user, developer, admin), email verification tokens, biography, and social links.
  • 3. DeveloperProfile & 4. VerificationRequest: Verified badge status, GitHub/website ownership evidence, and admin review notes.
  • 5. Category & 6. Launcher: Slugs, editions, supported OS, moderation status (pending, approved, rejected), featured flag, and external URLs.
  • 7. LauncherScreenshot & 8. LauncherVersion: Ordered gallery images and release changelogs with optional SHA-256 hashes.
  • 9. DownloadLink & 10. DownloadEvent: Per-OS external targets and anonymized IP-hashed click telemetry.
  • 11. Review, 12. Report, 13. Notification, 14. AdminActivityLog: 1–5 star ratings, suspicious link reports, in-app alerts, and immutable moderation audit trails.

Windows Local Setup (VS Code) & Linux VPS Production Commands

1. Local Development (Windows PowerShell) 
python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
pip install -r requirements.txt
Copy-Item .env.example .env
python -m backend.seed
uvicorn backend.main:app --reload --port 8000
2. Production Admin Bootstrap & HTTPS Linux VPS 
# /opt/blockhub/.env (Server-Side Only — Never Commit)
FIRST_ADMIN_EMAIL=krish137u@gmail.com
FIRST_ADMIN_PASSWORD=YOUR_NEW_STRONG_UNIQUE_PASSWORD

# Initialize DB, Nginx + Let's Encrypt HTTPS & Daily Backups
/opt/blockhub/.venv/bin/python -m backend.seed
sudo certbot --nginx -d blockhub.yourdomain.com
sudo cp deploy/backup_db.sh /etc/cron.daily/blockhub-backup
